title: BENCHMARKING ETHICAL AND SAFETY RISKS OF HEALTHCARE LLMS IN CHINA – TOWARD SYSTEMIC GOVERNANCE UNDER HEALTHY CHINA 2030
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking ethical risks in medical LLMs. It introduces a 12,000-item dataset specifically covering 11 dimensions of medical ethics, such as patient autonomy, beneficence, non-maleficence, and justice, and evaluates model decision-making on these ethical dilemmas.
